text: If he wanted to, he would. I decided not to accept the bare minimum and set my expectations and standards up to here, boo. Stop accepting the bare minimum. Women are in control of setting the dating pool standard. Get that through your head. The second everyone stops tolerating all the bare minimum, gee, I wonder what could happen. If he wanted to, he would. Yeah, that line sounds good on TikTok, but in real life, it doesn't usually work like that. There are a lot of things people want in this world but can't do, at least not right now. You can have it as a goal and work towards it, but it doesn't mean you can have it in the moment. Wanting and being able to do something are two different things. This applies to dating too. Remember, as a guy, yes, you should initiate, you should take the lead, show interest, plan the date, and so on. But once you've done that, once you've shown you care, once you have put in an effort, and she still treats it like it's a bare minimum, run. Because a woman who sees everything you do as not enough will never be satisfied. For her, if he wanted to, he would. Thinking would have no limit. And yeah, she might find a guy who keeps bending over backwards for her, doing everything and getting nothing back, but that shouldn't be you. You are not supposed to be her personal entertainment, emotional support, and ATM all-in-one. You should look for a woman who reciprocates, who meets you halfway, who appreciates what you bring, who understands your effort even when life gets tough. Because that's how real relationships work, not through TikTok quotes, but through empathy, gratitude, and balance.
